depiction.primary_object: silhouette of an airplane tilted nose-down
modifiers: horizontal bar underneath representing ground or runway
depiction.composition: side profile, airplane angled down to the right above a horizontal baseline

readings.meaning: return flight or arriving at destination

ambiguity: Can be confused at a quick glance with the airplane takeoff/departures icon, which differs only in the upward tilt of the plane.

modifier_semantics.modifier: horizontal bar underneath combined with downward tilt

reasoning: Shows the standard airport pictogram for flight arrivals (an airplane angled nose-down toward a runway line). It is ideal for tasks about landing, arriving at a destination, airport pickups, and post-landing logistics, though at tiny sizes it must be distinguished from the nose-up takeoff/departure icon.
